title: 2191. Row and Column Sums of a Matrix
description:
ints & Solutions

. 
 Row and Column Sums of a Matrix
40
Medium
Problem Statement
Read a matrix of integers and print the sum of each row and the sum of each column.
Description
A matrix (a table of numbers) with r rows and c columns is given. Find the sum of the numbers in each row and the sum of the numbers in each column, and print them.
Input Description
The first line contains two integers r and c, separated by a space. (1 <= r, c <= 5) Each of the next r lines contains c integers separated by single spaces. (Each integer is between -100 and 100)
Output Description
Print 2 lines. Line 1: the sums of the rows, from the first row to the last row. Line 2: the sums of the columns, from the first column to the last column. Print each result as a list in square brackets, with the numbers separated by a comma and a space, for example [6, 15].
Sample Input
2 3
1 2 3
4 5 6
Sample Output
[6, 15]
[5, 7, 9]
